items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 8 follow-ups addressed: computed package hash + plugin-change fingerprint, PID lock, pipelineStarted flag, wider S05 scan incl. scheme-less URLs, per-panel badges, S08 needs >=1 gate, duplicate python tests removed, wording. Item 7: two clear duplicates deleted and the hash re-check inside the third removed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Fingerprint returns 'unknown' on git failure (resume already refuses unknown); packageDigest throws on non-hex output; stale lock is taken over.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Child processes use fixed argv, no shell; no secrets handled; the project under test is only read.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New unit tests assert outcomes: lock/stale lock, started flag, fingerprint changes with untracked edits, hash equals recorded, S05 hits and non-hits, S08 zero gates.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Operator-run harness; one git diff and one python call per run.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New run-identity.ts; e2e.spec.ts 262 lines, all ts under the 300 cap.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: uv/python hash call and git are exercised for real by the unit test; per-panel badge script is browser-only and not unit-tested (stated limit: boards without tabpanel fall back to document scope).
